name: Kiva
head: Kiva: what they want, what they hate, how they feel about us
about: Kiva is a global microfinance nonprofit. People lend as little as $25 to entrepreneurs, get repaid, and lend again. Brit (Director of Communications) reviews every Vishal edit. Kathryn (Creative) now owns the partnership, and Homero (Project Manager) joins the calls. Vishal is Kiva's CEO and the face of the current series. Our lead: Nick.

rel.note: Brit called the first CEO videos “great so far” and gives us room on timing. Kiva has named video a growth area.

ver.note: Last 90 days, 26 Kiva cuts. Kiva average V2.46 vs agency V1.96. 73% of Kiva cuts went past V1 (agency 50%).

read.chip: Captions must be right on V1
read.note: Brit had to send the same caption spec twice. Names, captions and line breaks are what she checks first. Most of her Frame.io notes are caption fixes.

quotes.q: Reviewed all 3 CEO videos - they're great so far!
Once we lock in that caption style, we can move forward with the rest of the videos.
Can we increase the kerning slightly as well? The characters feel a little cluttered.
Specifically, I'm looking for Vishal's response to “What does it mean to be a part of the Kiva community?” video, as we want to include that in an upcoming donation campaign.

loves: The person's own story as the hero. Kiva is the turning point in it, not the star.
Real footage over stock. Any stock must be diverse and not corporate.
Vishal's casual walk-and-talk style, distinct from sit-down interviews.
Vishal on real topics: impact, refugees, current events. Less generic B-roll.
A vertical version of every video.
The tagline “Give a little. Change a lot.”
hates: The word “investment” on screen. It is a legal ban.
Wrong names. It is Vishal Ghotge, never the transcript's “Kodke”.
Big lime captions and crowded letters.
Corporate or non-diverse stock. Clips from the same brand back to back.
how_to_cut: Hook on frame 1. No name plate, logo or fade at 0:00.
Staff supers read “Name” / “Title at Kiva”. Borrowers read “Job title, Country”.
CEO series captions: about 25% smaller, in the lower third, Kiva green #2AA967, a little less blur, a little more letter spacing, soft shadow.
Captions match every word. Break lines at natural phrases.
Leave breathing room between voice sections. Music low.
Music from premiumbeat.com only, warm and hopeful. Check copyright on anything over 1 minute.
New green K logo in a top corner, never on frame 1.
End card: “Give a little. Change a lot.” plus kiva.org. Deliver 16:9 and 9:16.

perf.note: Instagram @kiva.org reels, last 90 days. Public data, views only. Tap a reel to watch it.

rows.t: Kristina, Caked and Baked (Black Business Month)

perf.foot: Three of the top five are one-person borrower stories, and Shalita and Dr. Gladney are from our Baltimore shoot. The how-it-works explainer did 911 views, a useful benchmark for the Vishal loan explainer. No Vishal reel is posted on Instagram yet.

brand.note: Post Grotesk for text, Dovetail MVB as the serif. On the Vishal CEO series, captions are Kiva green #2AA967; the older #EDF4F1-on-#223829 caption pairing is not used there. The yellow kiva.org on end cards is accepted, do not change it.

## Typo-QA Glossary
_Canonical on-screen spellings for the `typo-qa` tool. Mined 2026-05-31 from this client's MD + web-verified names. extract.sh reads the PRIME line to prime Whisper; the reader diffs captions against these._
**Kansas City Hub speakers — all four web-verified 2026-07-29 (typo-qa on KIVAKansasCityHubHighlight001 V6). ⚠️ The Monday edit brief for that video misspelled EVERY ONE of them; the ON-SCREEN supers were right. Never "correct" these toward the brief.**
- **Nia Webster** — Assistant Director, Neighborhood Services Department, City of Kansas City MO (oversees the KC BizCare small-business office). "Nia" NOT "Neha" (the brief said "Neha"). Verified: LinkedIn, kcmo.gov, Startland News. On-screen super abbreviates the org to "KCMO".
- **Brandy Poiry** — Administrative Director, Gioiosa Montessori (Roeland Park KS); opened the school with her sister Teresa Glenn. "Poiry" NOT "Porre" (the brief said "Porre"). Verified: LinkedIn, gioiosamontessori.com.
- **EDCKC** — Economic Development Corporation of Kansas City, MO; all caps, no periods, as supered.

- **Kiva** — org name; mixed-case "Kiva" (NOT "KIVA"). On-screen in staff supers as "Title at Kiva". Legal name "Kiva Microfunds".
- **Jibu** — the East/West African safe-drinking-water **franchise** brand whose franchisees appear as Kiva borrowers (the `KIVAWaterFranchiseJourney` shoot). Canonical **Jibu**, capital J, one word — confirmed 2026-07-31 against the subject's own branded shirt (carries the ® mark) and the shop signage in the same frames, not from the brief. Borrowers describe themselves as "a customer of Jibu" then "opened my own franchise"; they are **Jibu franchisees**, not Kiva staff — don't super them as Kiva.

- **Lyndsae' Peele** — Kiva U.S. Director (recently promoted from Sr. Entrepreneurial Ecosystem Manager, 2026-06). **The trailing apostrophe in "Lyndsae'" is part of her actual name — web-verified 2026-07-08** (thesupercrowd.com/lyndsae-peele, Kingdom Vision Consulting, The Walt Weekly, her own bio "Lyndsae' Peele, MBA"). NEVER "flag" the apostrophe as a typo (Julie Monfelt lesson — our earlier context-log spelling "Lyndsae Peele" without the apostrophe was the INCOMPLETE one; the on-screen "Lyndsae' Peele" is CORRECT). Fathom mishears her as "Lindsay"/"Lindsae". On-screen lower-third super: **"Lyndsae' Peele" / "US Director, Kiva"** (verified on KIVALyndsaeFeatureTeasers V3, 2026-07-08). Possessive is "Lyndsae's".

- _Caption conventions (not single terms):_ borrowers = "Job title, Country"; Kiva staff = "Title at Kiva"; ambassadors = "Kiva lender and ambassador"; former staff prefix "Former". - **Raquel Rodriguez** — founder & owner, El Café Cubano (Kansas City). **NO accent on her name** — every public source writes "Raquel Rodriguez", not "Rodríguez" (Kansas City Mag, Startland News, EDCKC, her own site). ## 🎯 Goals & Preferences
_Created 2026-08-07 (typo-qa pillar 3 standing order — this file had no Goals section, so the pillar had nothing to grade against). Every line below is sourced from the Context Log / call records already in this file, not invented. Update in the same change whenever a new goal or preference is learned._
**Per-project exceptions (these OVERRIDE the global default):**
- **Kansas City set (Aug 2026, 6 traditionals)** — individual borrower/hub-staff profiles, **1–1.5 min, social-friendly, cut SHORTER than Lyndsae's** (7/20 call). They **ship as a SET**: the brief's standing instruction is *"MATCH THE TEMPLATE: Kiva KC Traditional - Brandy Porre … consistency across them matters more than anything individual."* Judge each cut against its siblings — lower-third styling, caption treatment, pacing, length, end card.
- **Lyndsae' Peele feature** — her journey to Kiva + philosophy as new U.S. Director (long-form + 15–45s vertical teasers). APPROVED 7/20.
- **"Postcard from KC"** — compilation format (staff + entrepreneurs + community pride) intended to become the **standard format for all future hub visits**.
- **Vishal Ghotge (CEO) Seattle** — ~12 short-form (<1 min) **thought-leadership** pieces, ~70% Kiva-focused. Different register from borrower stories: authority, not testimony.
- **Anniversary content** — always include a year-milestone title screen ("Celebrating 20 years of impact").
**HARD RULES (a break here is a finding, not a preference):**
- ⛔ **Never use the word "investment"** — legal prohibition. Substitute "vote of confidence" or similar.
- ⛔ **"U.S." never "United States"** — logged as a guaranteed revision if missed.
- ⛔ **Caption/title standards** — borrowers = "Job title, Country"; Kiva staff = "Title at Kiva"; ambassadors = "Kiva lender and ambassador"; former staff prefix "Former". _(⚠️ The Aug 2026 KC set supers borrowers as "Borrower, Owner of <business>" per the Brandy Porre template — flagged to Atdhe 2026-08-07 as a template-vs-standard conflict; until he rules, MATCH THE TEMPLATE and do not post against it.)_
- End-card tagline, verbatim: **"Give a little. Change a lot."**
- Caption/subtitle box hex **#223829** (client-given, 2026-03-26), text `#EDF4F1`. **The end-card URL yellow is an accepted off-palette accent — CLOSED, never re-raise** (see the ⛔ CLOSED block below).
**Editorial preferences (judgment, not hard rules):**
- Authentic borrower footage **over** corporate stock; stock must be racially diverse and not overly corporate.
- Avoid consecutive clips from the same organization's brand; slow down transitions between VO sections (breathing room).
- Music: **premiumbeat.com** royalty-free (desert-ride / baile-funk-trap-groove styles preferred). Check copyright on anything >1 min for YouTube/socials.
- Vertical versions required for all content.
- **They fact-check titles meticulously** and review collaboratively with "+1" endorsements; multi-round cycles are normal. Names/orgs on screen are the #1 thing they catch — research every proper noun against the glossary above before it supers.
**Review routing (from the 8/3 call):** tag **Brit Heiring** on Vishal edits; tag **Cynthia Betubiza** on entrepreneur videos. Cynthia now leads all future filming strategy.
